title: Selling and Promotion - Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA - Selling: Customer Service
subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: How does excellent customer service directly impact the selling process in the long term?
options: It decreases the need for a marketing department.
It builds customer loyalty, leading to repeat business and positive word-of-mouth.
It completely eliminates product returns.
It allows a company to sell faulty products without repercussions.
questions.explain: Good customer service fosters trust and loyalty, which are essential for repeat purchases and creating brand advocates.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Why is the follow-up stage of the selling process closely tied to customer service?
options: Because the salesperson needs to ensure the customer's payment cleared the bank.
Because it ensures customer satisfaction, addresses any post-purchase issues, and sets the stage for future sales.
Because salespeople are required to log a certain number of phone calls per day.
Because it is the only way to send a customer their receipt.
questions.explain: Follow-up is a core customer service action in sales that verifies satisfaction with the product and resolves any early issues, building trust.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: When handling a customer complaint, what is typically the best first step for a salesperson or customer service rep to take?
options: Immediately offer a full refund to get them to leave.
Explain why the company's policy does not allow returns.
Listen attentively to the customer without interrupting.
Transfer the customer to another department to avoid conflict.
questions.explain: Active listening shows empathy and respect, allowing the representative to fully understand the problem before offering a solution.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: Which concept focuses on creating long-term partnerships with customers rather than just focusing on single, transactional sales?
options: Relationship marketing
Transactional selling
Hard-selling
Mass marketing
questions.explain: Relationship marketing aims to build deep, long-term relationships with customers to earn their ongoing business and loyalty.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: How can order processing effectively serve as a customer service tool?
options: By overcharging the customer to increase profit margins.
By ensuring orders are accurate, filled quickly, and delivered on time.
By keeping the shipping status a secret so it is a surprise.
By requiring customers to fill out lengthy forms for every purchase.
questions.explain: Accurate and efficient order fulfillment prevents frustration and is a crucial, practical element of good customer service.
questions.subject: Intro to Marketing Concepts FBLA

questions.q: An automated email confirming a customer's purchase and providing tracking information is an example of:
options: Personal selling
Customer service enhancing the post-sale experience
Pre-approach strategy
Institutional advertising
questions.explain: Post-sale communication, like order tracking, keeps the customer informed and is a key automated customer service tool.
